addAction.title: New server display preference
addAction.subtitle: How should displayed servers update after this add?

error.label: Server unreachable
error.subtitle: Could not connect to {{server}}. Check that the server is running and your network is reachable.

indexing.label: Scanning and indexing conversations…
indexing.subtitle: Your server is warming up and building its conversation index for the first time. This only happens once — history will appear as soon as it's ready.

cacheAlert.title: {{missing}} of {{total}} conversation histories are missing on {{server}}
cacheAlert.backupHint: Consider checking a Time Machine (or equivalent) backup before doing anything destructive.
cacheAlert.confirmPruneAll: This permanently removes all {{count}} missing conversations from the cache. This cannot be undone.
cacheAlert.confirmPruneSelected: This permanently removes {{count}} selected conversations from the cache. This cannot be undone.
cacheAlert.confirmResetRescan: This resets the cache and rescans from disk. This cannot be undone.
cacheAlert.selectAtLeastOne: Select at least one conversation to prune.

claudeFlags.title: Claude CLI flags
claudeFlags.description: Applied to every session this server starts. Takes effect on the next session.
claudeFlags.notPersisted: This server was started with command-line flags, so changes apply now but reset on restart.
claudeFlags.extraArgsUnsupported: Passed through as-is and not validated. Use at your own risk.
claudeFlags.dangerousExplanation: Claude will run commands on this machine without asking you first, for every future session. Anyone with this server's API key gets the same power.

permissionMode.label: Permission mode
permissionMode.description: How much Claude asks before acting. Bypass modes remove every confirmation.

addDir.label: Additional directories
addDir.description: Extra folders Claude may read and edit, beyond the project.

allowedTools.label: Allowed tools
allowedTools.description: Only these tools run without asking. A safer alternative to bypass mode.

disallowedTools.label: Blocked tools
disallowedTools.description: Tools Claude may never run on this server.

maxBudgetUsd.label: Budget limit (USD)
maxBudgetUsd.description: Caps what one session can spend. Useful when prompts are disabled.

fallbackModel.label: Fallback model
fallbackModel.description: Model to switch to if the main one is unavailable.
